summary.en: Later on, while they are going to the mountains and investigating the cottage of the hideout cottage of the wanted robber. And they heard a car going forward and it was accelerated. While they are investigating the cottage, they heard the braking of the car and found a younger detective named Akiyama, who had been missing for a while much to Yui's worry. Akiyama was tied to a car (Silver Suzuki Swift) in a hanging noose, then the car fell off from the cliff, decapitating the unfortunate Akiyama. The robber's corpse were found in that burning car. After a while, Akiyama was found tied in car trunk shouting "My phone, my phone!!!". The car fell and he was decapitated in front of Yui, Morofushi, Saegusa and Kuroda. They think Yamato is the one who did the serial killing, as Bishamonten. So their boss Kuroda Hyoue told them that ti put BOLO on Yamato.
